title: leibnitzia ruficoma
intro: Leibnitzia ruficoma, commonly known as Prickly Chrysanthemum or Rough Chrysanthemum, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidative, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Leibnitzia ruficoma include sedative, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
